summary: The live permission prompt is a flat 6-label choice list built by open_permission_with_persistent (native_view_dialogs.rs:1342), driven live from tui_entry.rs:8155. The upstream-correct PermissionPrompt model (native_permissions.rs:557, PermissionStage::NestedReject at :520) is DEAD CODE: zero non-test callers, and its two required sub-behaviors cannot be rendered because DialogView (native_view_dialogs.rs:429) and OpenDialog (:398) carry NO stage field and NO textarea/input field. Sub-behavior 1 (3-option realign) is NOT a parity bug: the live 6-choice scoped set is a protected extension; the server supports scope in {once,session,always} (run_owner.rs:232) and the save gate only drops 'Always allow'. Sub-behaviors 3 (always-body swap) and 4 (nested rejection stage) DO require a stage enum + textarea field on DialogView/OpenDialog that does not exist at HEAD, so no bounded live-wired patch is possible without inventing new dialog view state and a new live render consumer. Do not stub.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: Neither DialogView nor OpenDialog has a stage field nor a textarea/input field. PermissionStage::NestedReject (native_permissions.rs:520) requires a distinct render stage; the always-body swap (upstream permission.tsx:217-260) requires a second body form on the same dialog. The live builder only ever produces a flat choices list plus a static message_lines body; there is no field to store or transition a stage, and no field to capture rejection-message input.
missing_seams.required_producer: A stage enum field (Select / ConfirmAlways / NestedReject) plus a rejection-message text buffer field on OpenDialog/DialogView, and a live render consumer that reads the stage each frame and paints the corresponding body/textarea.

missing_seams.required_producer: The live builder must populate the new stage field (see above) so the renderer can drive the always-body swap and the nested reject stage.
